# jamfplatform_pro_computer_invitation (List Resource)

Lists all Jamf Pro computer enrollment invitations. Invitations carry no name and Jamf Pro exposes no filter parameters for them, so this list resource takes no filter configuration.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Enrollment | Enrollment invitations | Read | `enrollment-invitations` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every Jamf Pro computer enrollment invitation. Computer invitations carry
# no name, so this list resource takes no filter configuration. Note: the
# invitation list can lag newly created invitations, so a just-created
# invitation may not appear here immediately.
list "jamfplatform_pro_computer_invitation" "all" {
  provider = jamfplatform
}
```
